name: CULane: Large-Scale Benchmark for Traffic Lane Detection
description: CULane is a large-scale lane detection dataset collected by roof-mounted cameras on vehicles driving through Beijing. Comprising 133,235 roadway video frames annotated with pixel-level lane boundaries, capturing urban, highway, night, shadow, dazzle light, and heavy traffic conditions across 8 dynamic driving scenarios.
